Uttar Pradesh and Odisha face floods, thousands evacuated

Flooding has affected Uttar Pradesh, with 26 districts inundated and over 3.53 lakh people impacted. Authorities have evacuated 17,544 people to safer locations, and 4,847 are currently in relief shelters. In Odisha, the flood situation has improved as major rivers receded, though nearly 2 lakh people in 303 villages across Balasore and Jajpur districts remain affected. The Odisha government reported 53,986 people are still in relief camps.
